source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue after independently preparing receiver-green upstream PRs #445 (the Galois group of Q(zeta_8)/Q is Klein four) and #446 (the Gaussian quadratic subfield Q(i)). Because those prerequisite PRs were still open, the producer created a temporary integration base containing their exact accepted heads and developed this next structural slice only against that combined state. Mathlib's Projectivization.card_of_finrank_two then gives cardinality 2+1=3.
